_comment_enableMemoryPolicy: inject <roaming-memory-policy> into system prompt at agent start (default true)
_comment_enableMemoryProposeNudge: periodic propose reminder; never auto-approves (explicit user approval required)
_comment_memoryProposeNudgeMode: nudge delivery: status = one-line footer notice, no transcript spam (default); followUp = legacy synthetic review message
_comment_handoffRearmPercent: minimum raw ContextUsage.percent growth before repeat trigger, >0..100; default 25
_comment_handoffMode: shadow keeps pi-auto-handoff; owner registers /handoff+/lanjut — remove legacy package first
